meaning: Params.jl:430 hard-asserts that the learned compliance law's weight file holds exactly 25 numbers, aborting the model build otherwise. It pins the NN for Veins.C_v to one fixed shape.

could_move.what: Any retrained weight set with a different width, supplied via _NN_FILE, fails to load, so Model_6 cannot be built or fitted at all.
The 25-weight shape must match how Elements.jl's Brain_1 unpacks NN_THETA at build time; a wrong packing order would change C_v without tripping this check.
A weight file of the right length but trained under different squash bounds would pass this check yet shift C_v.
Deck output, since m6 is the only model reached and it feeds one comparison deck.

expectation: Unknown in magnitude. When it passes, the check changes no numbers; it only gates the build. It does not catch a wrong-but-25-long weight file, so I cannot call it a sufficient safeguard.

check.why: Builds Model_6 and exercises the weight-length assert and NN unpacking without running the fit stage.
